Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :donor_id_print_det.donor_id is not null then
 BEGIN
 select initcap(last_name ||', '||first_name) 
 into :donor_id_print_det.donor 
 from donors 
 where donor_id = :donor_id_print_det.donor_id 
 and rownum = 1;
 EXCEPTION 
 when no_data_found then
 :donor_id_print_det.donor := 'Not found';
 END;
end if;

if :donor_id_print_det.donor_id is not null then
 BEGIN
 select replace(replace(replace(description,'Neg','-'),'Pos','+'),' ','')
 into :donor_id_print_det.blood_type 
 from valid_master_codes, donors 
 where donors.blood_type = valid_master_codes.code
 and code_type = 'ABO' 
 and donor_id = :donor_id_print_det.donor_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1)
 and rownum = 1;
 
 EXCEPTION 
 when no_data_found then null;
 when others then handle_error; check_package_failure; 
 END;
end if;

if :donor_id_print_det.donor_id is not null then
 declare
 dtTempElig1 date;
 begin 
 dtTempElig1 := next_eligformula( :donor_id_print_det.donor_id,
 'WB', 'AL', :donor_id_print_det.coll_date );
 :donor_id_print_det.next_elig_date := dtTempElig1;
 end;
end if;
if :donor_id_print_det.donor_id is not null then
 declare
 dtTempElig2 date;
 begin 
 dtTempElig2 := next_eligformula( :donor_id_print_det.donor_id,
 'PP', 'AL', :donor_id_print_det.coll_date );
 :donor_id_print_det.next_wb_date := dtTempElig2;
 end;
end if;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :history.coll_date is not null then
 begin
 select absorbance 
 into :chol_level
 from unit_test_results
 where test_id = 'CHOL' 
 and unit_id in
 (select unit_id 
 from donations 
 where donor_id = :donor_id_print_det.donor_id 
 and coll_date = :history.coll_date );
 
 exception
 when no_data_found then null;
 when others then handle_error; check_package_failure;
 end;
end if;
if :history.coll_date is not null then
 begin
 select a.physical_value || '/' || b.physical_value
 into :history.bp_pulse
 from physical_findings a, physical_findings b
 where a.physical_code = 'BPSY' and b.physical_code = 'BPDI'
 and a.transaction_id in (select transaction_id from donations
 where donor_id = :donor_id_print_det.donor_id
 and coll_date = :history.coll_date)
 and b.transaction_id = a.transaction_id;

-- and coll_date = :history.coll_date);

 end;
end if;

ProgramUnit.Name: NEXT_ELIGFORMULA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
function NEXT_ELIGFormula(sDonorId donors.donor_id%TYPE,
 proc_code donations.procedure_code%TYPE, 
 don_type donations.donation_type%TYPE,
 dtCollDt donations.coll_date%TYPE )
 return date is
 v_elig_status varchar2(20);
 v_def_date date := null;
 v_inter_type varchar2(20);
 v_reason varchar2(200);

begin
 /* dtTempElig1 := next_eligformula( :donor_id_print_det.donor_id,
 'WB', 'AL', :donor_id_print_det.coll_date );
 dtTempElig2 := next_eligformula( :donor_id_print_det.donor_id,
 'PP', 'AL', :donor_id_print_det.coll_date );
*/ 
 don_core.CHECK_ELIGIBILITY(sDonorId, proc_code, don_type, dtCollDt,
 NULL, -- donor weight -- pkg will get weight from donors table if NULL is passed.
 v_elig_status,v_def_date,v_inter_type,v_reason);

 --message( to_char(v_def_date)|| ' ' || v_elig_status);
 IF v_def_date is null and v_elig_status = 'Y' THEN
 V_def_date := sysdate;
 END IF;
 return v_def_date; 

 --return sysdate;
exception
 when others then
 v_def_date := null;
 return v_def_date;
 return null;
end;
